decisions.decision: Alaric's motivation is protective duty rather than revenge.
Alaric becomes the first human Dragon Rider Knight.
Alaric replaces retiring Galahad as one of three paladins at age twenty-eight.
The war is ended by taking the offensive against the Dark God rather than continuing indefinite defensive warfare.
Alaric defeats the Dark God with the Sword of the Dawn provided by the Lady of the Lake.

note: Only decisions clearly recoverable from source material are recorded. Rationale is omitted where it was not explicitly preserved.
